question.problem:
$\,$ $P(x):$ $4\,|\,x$ $\,$ $Q(x):$ $x$ is composite

Consider the predicates $P(x)$ and $Q(x)$ above. Which of the following expresses the conditional predicate $P(x)⇒Q(x)?$

I. Whenever $4\,|\,x,$ then $x$ is composite

II. $4\,|\,x$ whenever $x$ is composite

III. $x$ is composite, provided that $4\,|\,x$
question.worked_solution:
Given that the implication $P⇒Q$ is true, we have the following:

- Whenever $P,$ then $Q$

- $Q$ whenever $P$

- $Q,$ provided that $P$

With that in mind, let's examine the given options.

- Option I reads

$$
\text{Whenever}\,{{4\,|\,x}_{⏟}}_{P(x)},\,\text{then}\,{{x\text{ is composite}}_{⏟}}_{Q(x)}
$$

which corresponds to $P(x)⇒Q(x).$ $\,✓$

- Option II reads

$$
{{4\,|\,x}_{⏟}}_{P(x)}\,\text{whenever}\,{{x\text{ is composite}}_{⏟}}_{Q(x)}
$$

which corresponds to $Q(x)⇒P(x).$ $\,\times $

- Option III reads

$$
{{x\text{ is composite,}}_{⏟}}_{Q(x)}\,\text{provided that}\,{{4\,|\,x}_{⏟}}_{P(x)}
$$

which corresponds to $P(x)⇒Q(x).$ $\,✓$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only."
